These quadratic polynomials are palindromic, meaning each has the form \( x^2 + b_i x + 1 \) because the product of their constant terms must be 1 (as seen from the constant term of the given polynomial).

2. \( b_1 b_2 + b_1 b_3 + b_2 b_3 = -2 \) (from the coefficient of \( x^4 \))
3. \( b_1 b_2 b_3 = 1 \) (from the coefficient of \( x^3 \))

Thus, the value of \( b_1 c_1 + b_2 c_2 + b_3 c_3 \) is \(\boxed{-1}\).
